_comment: GSD workflow-specific hooks - merge with project hooks as needed

preToolUse.command: bash -c 'if echo "$SKILL" | grep -qE "gsd:(execute-phase|plan-phase|new-project)"; then echo "💡 GSD Workflow Tips:"; echo "- Execute phases atomically (one logical chunk at a time)"; echo "- Write continuation prompts between phases"; echo "- Update ROADMAP.md after completing phases"; fi'

preToolUse.description: Check if commit aligns with GSD phase
preToolUse.command: bash -c 'if [ -f ".planning/ROADMAP.md" ]; then echo "💡 Does this commit complete a GSD phase/milestone?"; echo "Consider: /gsd:progress to update phase status"; fi'

postToolUse.command: bash -c 'if echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -q "PLAN.md"; then echo "✅ Plan updated. Remember:"; echo "- Plans should be executable (specific, not vague)"; echo "- Include success criteria"; echo "- Link to relevant architecture docs"; fi'

sessionStart.command: bash -c 'if [ -f ".planning/ROADMAP.md" ]; then echo "📋 GSD Project Detected"; echo "Current status: Use /gsd:progress to check"; echo "Available: /gsd:plan-phase, /gsd:execute-phase, /gsd:checkpoint"; fi'
